response.sql: SELECT c.zoneref, s.insurstat, COUNT(*) AS conservation_count, COUNT(*)::numeric / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS fraction FROM scanconservation AS c JOIN sites AS s ON s.zoneregistry = c.zoneref GROUP BY c.zoneref, s.insurstat ORDER BY fraction DESC NULLS LAST, s.insurstat NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
